PO.Data: Front-end component overrides declared by plugins.

Maintain the mapping between dictionary artifacts (windows, processes, reports, forms, smart browses) and the front-end component a plugin loads for them. Rows are normally mirrored from the plugin manifest; this window is for inspection and support.
Personalizaciones de componentes de front declaradas por plugins.

Mantiene el mapeo entre artefactos del diccionario (ventanas, procesos, reportes, formularios, smart browses) y el componente de front que un plugin carga para ellos. Normalmente las filas se reflejan desde el manifiesto del plugin; esta ventana es para inspección y soporte.
Declares dependency and compatibility of a plugin against other plugins, by package Value.

Dependencies are declared against the target plugin's Value (stable across environments), never its ID (which differs per environment/tenant). Resolution to a concrete installed plugin happens at runtime. A single DependencyType list covers both dependency (REQ/OPT/REC) and conflict (INC).
Members of a group/category UI override.
When a AD_PluginUIOverride is a group (IsSpecificComponent = 'N'), these rows list the specific artifacts that belong to the group. All members share the parent's ComponentPath.
Declares which front-end component a plugin loads when a window, process, report, form or smart browser is opened.

Each row maps an artifact (or a group/category of artifacts) to a component path. Resolution at runtime returns the applicable row with the lowest SeqNo. A specific override targets one artifact via its FK; a group override lists its members in AD_PluginUIComponent; a group override with no members applies to every artifact of the given ComponentType (default theme).
Limits the ComponentType combo to Window, Process, Report, Form and Smart Browse.

There are two methods of making records unavailable in the system: One is to delete the record, the other is to de-activate the record. A de-activated record is not available for selection, but available for reports. There are two reasons for de-activating and not deleting records: (1) The system requires the record for audit purposes. (2) The record is referenced by other records. E.g., you cannot delete a Business Partner, if there are invoices for this partner record existing. You de-activate the Business Partner and prevent that this record is used for future entries.
